descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Consultanță și servicii de afaceri
Join LIAMIS , an innovative IT company specializing in software solutions for image and video analysis, computer vision, and pattern recognition. We partner with leading firms in Medical Devices and Eye/Gaze Tracking, contributing to cutting-edge advancements in science, medicine, and human-machine interaction.
 We are adding one more Manual Software Test Engineer to our team. 
 What You'll Be Doing : 
Develop comprehensive test plans for eye tracking applications
Execute tests as per defined plans and document results
Create reports summarizing testing activities
Contribute to software specification and system design discussions
 Must haves: 
Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields
Proven experience in professional software testing
Ability to develop and implement tests for software products
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently
Fluent in English
 Bonus Points for: 
Familiarity with version control systems like GIT and continuous build systems
Experience with automated testing tools (e.g., Squish, Ranorex)
Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., AutoIT, Python)
Familiarity with MatLab; some programming experience in C# is a plus
Experience with the NUnit framework for writing tests
 Perks: 
Flexible working hours and hybrid work options
Enjoy sweets, juices, and specialty coffee in our centrally located office near Eroilor
Pet-friendly workplace with personalized workspaces
Medical subscription with Regina Maria for you and your family
Personalized development plan with manager support
